description.narrative: This project aims to strengthen the Yemen Red Crescent Society’s (YRCS) readiness and ability to respond swiftly and effectively to emergencies across priority governorates. It enhances community-level disaster preparedness through the prepositioning of 1,000 NFI kits, improved early‑warning systems, and strengthened emergency response teams and funds. The project supports continuity of essential health services by providing two ambulances and enhancing epidemic readiness through trained rapid response teams, essential supplies, and targeted community awareness. It further invests in YRCS’s institutional capacities by supporting volunteer welfare mechanisms, upgrading strategic warehouses, and improving monitoring, evaluation, and data management capacities across branches. Through these integrated interventions, YRCS will be better equipped to deliver timely, efficient, and accountable humanitarian assistance to vulnerable communities across.
